items.source:
Set the value for a parameter. The method used is based on the SQL type
of the parameter and we can handle complex types like arrays and LOBs.
items.translation: 设置参数的值。所使用的方法基于参数的 SQL 类型，并且我们可以处理数组和 LOB 等复杂类型。

items.source: ps - the prepared statement or callable statement
items.translation: ps - 预编译语句或可调用语句

items.source: paramIndex - index of the parameter we are setting
items.translation: paramIndex - 正在设置的参数的索引

items.source: Set the value for a parameter.
items.translation: 设置参数的值。

items.source:
Clean up all resources held by parameter values which were passed to an
execute method. This is for example important for closing LOB values.
items.translation: 清理传递给 execute 方法的参数值所持有的所有资源。这对于关闭 LOB 值尤其重要。

items.source: SQLException - if thrown by PreparedStatement methods
items.translation: SQLException - 如果由 PreparedStatement 方法抛出

items.source: paramValues - parameter values supplied. May be null.
items.translation: paramValues - 提供的参数值。可能为 null。

items.source: inValue - the value to set (plain value or an SqlTypeValue)
items.translation: inValue - 要设置的值（纯值或 SqlTypeValue）

items.source: The default is "false", trying getParameterType calls first and falling back to PreparedStatement.setNull(int, int) / PreparedStatement.setObject(int, Object, int) calls based on well-known behavior of common databases.
items.translation: 默认值为 "false"，会先尝试调用 getParameterType，然后回退到基于常见数据库的已知行为调用的 PreparedStatement.setNull(int, int) / PreparedStatement.setObject(int, Object, int)。

items.source: Consider switching this flag to "true" if you experience misbehavior at runtime, for example, with connection pool issues in case of an exception thrown from getParameterType (as reported on JBoss AS 7) or in case of performance problems (as reported on PostgreSQL).
items.translation: 如果运行时出现异常行为，例如在从 `getParameterType` 抛出异常时遇到连接池问题（如 JBoss AS 7 中报告的那样），或遇到性能问题（如 PostgreSQL 中报告的那样），请考虑将此标志切换为 "true"。

items.source:
Used by PreparedStatementCreatorFactory and CallableStatementCreatorFactory,
but also available for direct use in custom setter/creator implementations.
items.translation: 由 PreparedStatementCreatorFactory 和 CallableStatementCreatorFactory 使用，但也可供自定义 setter/creator 实现直接调用。

items.source:
Clean up all resources held by parameter values which were passed to an
execute method.
items.translation: 清理传递给 execute 方法的参数值所持有的所有资源。

items.source: Derive a default SQL type from the given Java type.
items.translation: 从给定的 Java 类型推导默认的 SQL 类型。

items.source: the corresponding SQL type, or SqlTypeValue.TYPE_UNKNOWN if none found
items.translation: 对应的 SQL 类型，或者如果未找到则返回SqlTypeValue.TYPE_UNKNOWN。

items.source: javaType - the Java type to translate
items.translation: javaType - 要翻译的 Java 类型

items.source: param - the parameter as it is declared including type
items.translation: param - 声明时的参数（包括类型）

items.source: inValue - the value to set
items.translation: inValue - 要设置的值

items.source: sqlType - the SQL type of the parameter
items.translation: sqlType - 参数的 SQL 类型

items.source: typeName - the type name of the parameter (optional, only used for SQL NULL and SqlTypeValue)
items.translation: typeName - 参数的类型名称（可选，仅用于 SQL NULL 和 SqlTypeValue）
